description: Wastewater connections per new home start is a dataset listed in Pierce County open data portal (internal.open.piercecountywa.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Pierce County. This dataset compares the number of new wastewater connections to the number of new home starts, presented as a ration of new connections per new home starts. For more information, please see and. Coverage: Pierce County, Washington. Its tags are tier 1, wastewater, new home starts. The table has 5 columns. Attribution on the portal: Planning and Public Works. The portal shows 2026-06-11 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-internal-open-piercecountywa-gov-portal.
